verdict.rationale: React's own docs establish the modular half of the story: apps are built from encapsulated components that manage their own state and compose into complex UIs, and components receive data from outside (react-gh-1, react-docs-11, react-docs-24). Nothing in the evidence documents a dependency-injection mechanism (e.g., context or providers), so the DI half of the story goes unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented dependency-injection support, guidance on injecting services or dependencies into components, and independent corroboration of DI-style architecture.
